The purpose of this study was to examine academics' views on the implications of artificial intelligence (AI)-supported verbal intelligence games for open and confirmatory inquiry, problem-solving, and scientific reasoning skills in education. A phenomenological research design, one of the qualitative research methods, was adopted in this study. Qualitative data were collected through a semi-structured interview form.
